description: The Opportunity Zoox's mission is to build a purpose-built robotaxi that gives the world a better way to ride. We are searching for a passionate engineer with a strong curiosity for optimizing build speeds and a commitment to empowering developers through metrics and advanced tooling within our fast-paced culture.
